name: Mingo County Oxycodone Dosage
citation: The Washington Post. (2019). DEA ARCOS pain pill database [Data set].
license: Public release via Washington Post / DEA ARCOS litigation
description: Daily oxycodone dosage shipped to Mingo County, West Virginia pharmacies (2006–2012). Concurrent retail and chain pharmacy dosage are provided as covariates.
preprocessing: 1. Source: ARCOS transaction export filtered to BUYER_COUNTY=MINGO, BUYER_STATE=WV, DRUG_NAME=OXYCODONE.
2. Aggregate transaction-level DOSAGE_UNIT to daily sums.
3. Split covariates by BUYER_BUS_ACT: Retail_Pharmacy_Dosage, Chain_Pharmacy_Dosage.
4. Reindex to complete daily calendar; fill no-transaction days with 0.
5. Timestamps as ISO-8601 UTC strings shared across variates.
6. Output CSV schema: variable_name, variable_unit, timestamps, values (3 variates).
